'''2012 Yavin 4 Regionals Scott LS Hidden Base (V)''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Scott]] at [[2012 Yavin 4 Regionals]] (Regionals).


== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Hidden Base (V) / Systems Will Slip Through Your Fingers (V)]]
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Regionals
